entries.name: Wire-like PbSe nanocrystal assemblies
entries.caption: Source microscopy and SAED support ordered assemblies of PbSe nanocrystals. A straight chain sketch does not establish atomic fusion, measured interface coordinates or a continuous bulk single-crystal wire.
